system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Matching files are read at load time and appended to the system prompt.
system_prompt_style.note: Quote paraphrased from '匹配的文件在加载时读取并追加到系统提示中' / prompt fragments; also SKILL.md always:true injection and MEMORY.md injection indicate runtime composition.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote:
It has file, search, and shell tools,
so it reads code, runs `git diff`, and runs tests on its own; you just give it a
task.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Session Store (JSONL, LRU cache, three-tier compaction, thread_id)
context_compaction.note: LLM compaction default; tool_output_pruning inferred from session JSONL + LLM compaction tiers (crates/octos-agent/src/compaction_tiered.rs).

observation_format.evidence_locator: README.md Use octos as a library @f049d87
observation_format.note: Text results are the stdout/stdout JSON protocol; browser/CDP tool may yield images (crates/octos-agent/src/tools/browser.rs); not directly evidenced.

tool_count.evidence_quote: **LRU tool deferral**: ~15 active tools for fast LLM reasoning, ~50 on demand.
tool_count.note: ~15 tools active in the LLM's schema list by default; registry holds ~50 built-in plus plugins and 8 app-skills.

edit_primitive.note: edit_file.rs / replacer.rs (search_replace), write_file.rs (whole file), apply_patch.rs and diff_edit.rs (unified diff).

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: The manifest declares what tools the skill provides. The LLM reads this to decide when and how to call your skill.
tool_schema_source.note: manifest.json input_schema is hand-written JSON Schema; MCP servers supply schemas via mcp_servers.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: `acp` | run octos as an [Agent Client Protocol](https://agentclientprotocol.com) agent over stdio
protocol_standardization.note: MCP both as client (mcp_servers) and server (mcp-serve); 'other' = ACP and UI Protocol v1.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: **Multi-LLM DOT pipelines**: Define workflows as DOT graphs. Per-node model selection. Dynamic parallel fan-out spawns N concurrent workers at runtime
loop_primitives.note: Default is the ReAct agent loop (crates/octos-agent/src/agent/loop_runner.rs); pipelines and swarm fan-out are config-reachable.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
`/goal <objective>` gives the agent a standing objective. After each turn it
checkpoints a **continuation**
planning_granularity.note: No stored task-list plan object evidenced; goals are objectives with budget, not structured plans.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: A single `octos chat` or session runs one agent.
multi_agent_topology.note: sub-agents, peers and swarm reachable via spawn_agent / peer_handoff / /api/swarm/dispatch.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote:
A running agent calls **`spawn_agent`** (or its MCP-backed `delegate` variant)
to hand a scoped task to a child that runs **in the same process**.
delegation_mechanism.note: The spawn tools sit in the default `coding` tool surface, so spawning is available by default.

human_in_loop.note: Default `ask` pauses on risky commands; mode is configurable.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Sticky thread_id + committed_seq**: Every SSE event is bound to a thread; replay is deterministic by committed sequence number
short_term_state.note: Session store plus task supervisor, cost ledger, loop_state.rs / turn_state.rs hold typed state beyond messages.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: **3-layer memory**: Long-term (entity bank, auto-injected), episodic (task outcomes in redb), session (JSONL + LLM compaction, three-tier).
long_term_memory.note: MEMORY.md file notes, skills from octos-hub, episodes.redb, HNSW vector + BM25.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: **Session time-travel**: `session/rollback` RPC with resume/rewind checkpoint pickers in both clients; every session can be rolled back to any prior user turn.

self_verification.evidence_quote:
aggregates the artifacts, gates the aggregate
through a **validator**
self_verification.note: validators.rs / verifier.rs and check.rs; swarm validator gate is the harness-enforced check; agent may run tests itself.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: `--no-retry` | off | disable automatic retry on transient LLM errors
retry_policy.note: Only transport-level LLM retry by default; no task-level re-attempt loop evidenced.

rollback.evidence_quote: `session/rollback` RPC with resume/rewind checkpoint pickers in both clients
rollback.note: crates/octos-agent/src/snapshot.rs and workspace_git.rs / workspace_history.rs also give git-based fencing (peer worktrees).

termination_condition.note: Goal token budget (default 2M) is the cost/token cap; loop_detect.rs provides stall detection; a turn ends when the model emits a final answer.

cost_controls.note: AdaptiveRouter → ProviderChain → RetryProvider with lane scoring = routing; cache handoff test and LRU caches indicate caching.

timeouts.evidence_quote: `timeout_secs` | No | 30 | Max execution time per tool call (1-600)
timeouts.note: No run-level wall-clock timeout found in README/docs.

execution_isolation.note: Agent runs as a local process on the host with OS-level sandbox helpers around tool execution; Docker backend reachable.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: *(omitted)* | *(omitted)* | **workspace-write + ask** — the default | read + write inside `--cwd`

network_policy.evidence_quote: `danger-full-access` | *(forced `never`)* | full access, no prompts | host filesystem + network, no approvals
network_policy.note: Network reach is governed by sandbox mode; SSRF protection always on, but no host allowlist evidenced.

permission_model.evidence_quote: read + write inside `--cwd`; pause for approval on risky commands
permission_model.note: Also ToolPolicy deny-lists and before_tool_call hooks (static_allowlist/policy_engine style) always active.

tracing.evidence_quote: It covers session open with cursor replay, streamed turns, durable persistence events, tool activity, approvals, background tasks, and rollback.
tracing.evidence_locator: README.md Clients and the UI Protocol @f049d87
tracing.note: JSONL session store + append_only_audit.rs + recorder.rs; no OpenTelemetry export evidenced.

replayability.evidence_quote: Every SSE event is bound to a thread; replay is deterministic by committed sequence number (M8.10).
replayability.note: Event replay is deterministic by sequence, but re-execution against a changed environment is not claimed.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: | `update` / `clean` / `completions` / `docs` | release check, cache cleanup, shell completions, doc generation |
eval_hooks.note: No benchmark evaluation runner appears in the CLI surface or file tree; only unit/integration tests.

guardrails.evidence_quote:
Guardrails that stay on even under `danger-full-access`/`--yolo`:
`before_tool_call` hooks, `ToolPolicy` deny-lists, SSRF protection,
`BLOCKED_ENV_VARS`.
guardrails.note: prompt_guard.rs and 67 prompt injection tests = input filters; sanitize.rs = output filtering.

target_domain.evidence_quote: chat with an agent that can run code, browse the web, remember things, schedule jobs, and build documents

open_source.evidence_quote: Octos is an open-source AI agent platform
open_source.note: LICENSE file present at repo root; licence type not quoted in evidence.

model_agnostic.note: octos-llm provider abstraction with AdaptiveRouter → ProviderChain → RetryProvider.
